title: [BUG] Overly-aggressive policy violation flagging
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [x] Anthropic API - Claude CLI version: v1.0.30 - Operating System: macOS - Terminal: Ghostty ## Bug Description I have a test that produces garbled content. Claude seems to have interpreted the truncated `PREFIX: hFCC...` and `PREFIX: HELL...` as swear words. It flags policy violation if either one of these is present. If I modify the `PREFIX:` content ## Steps to Reproduce Failing with both `PREFIX: hFCC...` and `PREFIX: HELL...`: Failing with just `PREFIX: hFCC...` changed to add one more character and `PREFIX: HELL...` preserved: Failing with `PREFIX: HELL...` changed to add one more character and `PREFIX: hFCC...` preserved: Allowed with both modified to add one more character:
author: adamavenir
